key_concepts: Decantation separates a less-dense substance from a denser one.
In decantation, the mixture is left undisturbed.
The less-dense substance can be removed by scooping with a spoon.
The less-dense substance can be removed by slowly pouring it out.
Oil in water can be separated by decantation.
Gasoline in water can be separated by decantation.
Floating fats in sinigang can be removed by decantation or scooping.
Mud and water can be separated by decantation.
Decantation can be used to remove oil or gasoline from an oil spill.
Components of a suspension can be separated by decantation.
The method used to separate a mixture depends on the type of mixture.
